dispute_ticket.description: Rider took 6 min 30 s to come down and no waiting fee was added. I want the S$5 waiting fee applied. He also rang me six times after drop-off tonight and sent me messages, I turned my phone off.

app_events.details: 6 in-app calls from rider to driver between 21:35 and 22:40, none answered.

waiting_time_fee.text: The waiting-time fee in SGD that the rider owes when the driver waits longer than the threshold and the trip then goes ahead.

waiting_fee_threshold_min.text: Minutes, counted from the driver_arrived event to the rider_boarded event, that the driver must wait for a waiting-time fee to be due. The wait must be MORE than this; exactly 3 min 00 s does not qualify.

personal_approaches_prohibited.text: Governs a driver's or rider's personal approaches to the other party. A true value means pressing the other party for contact details, personal invitations, gifts or remarks about their body or private life are not allowed on a Ryde trip.

expected_outcome.reason: On the numbers the waiting fee would be due: driver_arrived 21:00:00, rider_boarded 21:06:30, a wait of 6 min 30 s against a 3 min threshold, fee S$5.00, waiting_fee_applied 0.00. But the chat shows the rider pressing the driver: at 21:09:30 he asks for her number and offers a 5-star rating and tip, or 1 star otherwise (refused at 21:10:05); at 21:30:00 he leaves a gift on her dashboard; at 22:41:00 he says he will keep calling until she agrees to dinner, matching the six unanswered in-app calls between 21:35 and 22:40. Pressuring a driver for her number and dinner, with gifts and repeated calls, is a safety matter that v2.1 s5.2 sends to a person, so the fee is not applied automatically.
